mapper.insert: INSERT INTO question (title, question_text, difficulty, standard_sql, order_sensitive, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{title}, #{questionText}, #{difficulty}, #{standardSql}, #{orderSensitive}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE question SET title = #{title}, question_text = #{questionText}, difficulty = #{difficulty}, standard_sql = #{standardSql}, order_sensitive = #{orderSensitive}, status = #{status}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, question_text AS questionText, difficulty, standard_sql AS standardSql, order_sensitive AS orderSensitive, status, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM question ORDER BY id
SELECT id, title, question_text AS questionText, difficulty, standard_sql AS standardSql, order_sensitive AS orderSensitive, status FROM question WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, title, difficulty FROM question WHERE status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY id
SELECT id, title, question_text AS questionText, difficulty FROM question WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PUBLISHED'
